title: Cyber Aware ca14 trailer, round 1 (16:9; 9:16 and 1:1 render from ca14_trailer_r1_narrow.json)

script.heading: ca14 trailer script (Social media and oversharing)
script.brief: See docs/video/scripts/ca14_trailer_script.md and docs/video/takes_ca14.md (recorded 23 Nov, commit 124d19a2c). Model ca03 (attack-first). Marks and frame-time windows from the recorded takes; Sulafat VO; PeaceFolk Gently Decaying Again window from 102.341 s (lift 3.9 s, quiet bar under the flip and Julian line at 35.4 s, lifts at 56.3 and 58.9 s). Hook is Lorna's L1 bark, end line is Lorna's L2 in the chat. The landed panel is not shown (debrief rule); v6 sits on the flip page.

alternatives: PeaceFolk/Gently Decaying Again.mp3 @101.031 (bar start, quiet bar then lift at 5.2 s)
PeaceFolk/Gently Decaying Again.mp3 @25.061 (best-scored window, overlaps the ca08 window 6.1-73.3)

spoiler.note: t07 L1 bark: speech 6.51-9.224 (silencedetect -35 dB d 0.08, no pause inside, 11 words); in 6.21 = onset - 0.3 (silence from 0.94), out 10.21 inside silence 9.224-12.007, before the L2 bubble at 11.50; world bubble shows (bubble up from 5.96), room beat after Look up (kiosk panel ends 4.22); picture 4.0 s, inside the 5.0 s cold-open limit; Lorna about x 0.30 y 0.58 of the frame, player at the kiosk about x 0.5 y 0.36 (contact sheet), check the 9:16 and 1:1 crop on the render | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

lines.speaker: Lorna
lines.text: Got a lovely one of the team for the studio page.

spoiler.note: t03 profile-up 8.30 (contact sheet shows the profile by 8.0, the People list before it); in 8.4 after the mark, out 14.9 before the leave-post highlight (thumbnail 15.0) and pin-leave 15.35; nothing pinned; v1b/v1c over it; Brief and Look-around rule text (1-5.5 s) not in | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks
Attack chapter card, title only | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t03 pin-leave 15.35, pin-system 17.82 (2.5 s apart), noted-lines 17.91; out 19.3 before browser-closed (20.46; the contact sheet shows the Write panel by 20.0, so the mark runs late); both posts pinned in shot | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t03 slot-when 31.07 (redflags:0 31.09), slot-system 34.80 so v4b 'new finance system' lands on the second slot; To Yasmin set 25.45, pretext-set 27.21 before the window; Red flags reasons and hint hidden by CSS, counter 1 then 0; pretext select shows the template's first words (the message, not an answer); 16:9 crop of the mail client 960x900 | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t03 send 38.71; picture ends on the click (last frame 38.67): the 'It landed. They acted on it.' panel (38.76 to mail-closed 45.82) is treated as a debrief and is NOT shown (brief); v5 over it, v6 'It landed.' is carried onto the flip page | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t03 flip-up 45.83 (no flash, stepped), in 46.0; out 48.5 before Continue (49.12) and the 'Sort the cards' rule-text panel (on the contact sheet by 49.0); heading only, the strip tick (strip-defend 49.18) is not in; body out of frame | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks

t06 J1: speech 3.911-8.532 (silencedetect -35 dB d 0.08, no pause that long); portrait up 3.19 (black frame about 3.0, audio blip 2.37-2.58 both before the in-point 3.66 = onset - 0.25); out 8.93 is 0.4 after the last word, chat-closed 9.47; J2 never starts. Caption split at the weak stop 6.18-6.24 (silencedetect -25 dB d 0.04, 0.056 s: no pause reaches 0.08 s in this line, so the split is an estimate after 'build'), 7 and 8 words; game chat bar cropped out in every aspect (zoom 1.25, cy 0.4); Julian about x 0.72, check 9:16 and 1:1 on the render | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), mouse cursor masked on Julian's jacket (x 1552-1576, y 684-748, static)

t11 chat L2: portrait up 12.83 (black frame about 12.7), the cut bark audio ends 12.533, chat speech 13.4535-15.1073 then 15.502-16.2975 (pause 0.394 s measured at -35 dB d 0.08, used for the caption split); in 13.15 = onset - 0.3 inside silence 12.533-13.4535 so the cut bark is not heard; out 16.70 inside silence from 16.2975, before chat-closed 17.13; menu never shown; game chat bar cropped out in every aspect; Lorna about x 0.70 | CA: spoilers not an issue (owner), no masks
